_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — coordinates are at (0,0), deliberately chosen off the coast of west Africa ('null island') so this cannot be mistaken for a real pilot-region boundary. Real boundary acquisition (candidate: BKG administrative boundaries) is unstarted work, not yet in docs/data/sources.md — see roadmap §2.3. CRS is EPSG:4326, reprojected to EPSG:25832 by 02_reproject.sh exactly like a real boundary source would be.
